q: Lewis Bowen's sofic entropy (2010) extended measure-theoretic entropy to actions of sofic groups. For amenable groups, sofic entropy:
opts: Coincides with the classical Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy
Is always larger than KS entropy
exp: Bowen's theorem: for actions of amenable groups (which are sofic), sofic entropy coincides with the classical KS entropy. This provides a unified framework extending to all sofic groups.
